entities.summary: Zornitsa Nedyalkova Popgancheva, known professionally as Zornitsa Sofia, is a Bulgarian artist and filmmaker. She is best known for directing Mila from Mars (2004), which was Bulgaria's Academy Award for Best Foreign Language Film submission to the 77th Academy Awards. Her 2017 film Voevoda was screened at the Moscow International Film Festival.
